item.title: Milo Yiannopoulos, far-right critic of U.S. immigration, is deported from U.S.
item.description: The controversial commentator, who criticized feminism and Islam, was an enthusiastic supporter of President Trump's immigration crackdown. ICE says he was an "illegal alien."

item.title: Photos: See the aftermath of deadly flash floods in Nepal
item.description: Nepal officials say the death toll has continues to rise in Wednesday's floods that washed away communities in Nepal and Tibet, which is held by China. About 2,500 people are missing in both areas.

item.title: Opinion: Remembering Dolly Parton
item.description: She said she wasn't offended by dumb blonde jokes because "I know I'm not dumb...and I also know I'm not blonde!" We take a moment to remember the smart, funny and uniquely talented Dolly Parton.

item.title: The bridges of Rwanda open up new worlds
item.description: A charity built 96 bridges to connect communities separated by rivers and gorges. A new study looks at the life-changing impact of a concrete-and-steel pedestrian crossing.

item.title: Lights out, Instagram off? The changes to Meta for teens could be a big deal
item.description: Researchers and advocates are applauding the changes that Meta agreed to make for minors on Instagram and Facebook. Cutting kids off at night and during the school day are two big changes.

item.title: Why is one WNBA team calling in national security experts?
item.description: The WNBA's popularity has risen in recent years, but so have threats and abuse directed at its players. One team is taking a novel approach to this, by partnering with national security specialists.

item.title: How America celebrated and mourned Dolly Parton, in Nashville and beyond
item.description:
The great Dolly Parton died earlier this week and tributes have poured in from across the country.

Fans are mourning the loss of a country music icon who not only changed the musical landscape but gave back to communities with her Imagination Library program and donations to develop the Moderna COVID vaccine.
